Ethnographic map showing the percentage of Poles in the total population in quartile categories for use in determining the new post-war boundaries for Poland.

Ethnographic map showing the percentage of Poles in the total population in quartile categories for use in determining the new post-war boundaries for Poland. Covers the central Polish territory as at end of the First World War and the adjacent regions of Eastern Europe that contain Polish ethnic minorities. Also shows proposed boundaries of Lithuania. Heavily rubber-stamped by U.S. Department of State, but no direct statement of attribution is given. Manuscript: Pen-and-ink (india) and watercolors. The map sheet has been fold-lined into quarters in the past (now flat on a cloth backing) and is missing a small section of the left-side margin. Includes legend at lower right. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
